script_directives: Maintain a strict duration of 20-22 seconds; avoid complex jargon that stalls momentum.
Use a 'Problem-Agitation-Solution' structure where the first 5 seconds focus entirely on the financial pain point.

seo_directives: Use high-intent keywords in the title that reflect a 'Stop' or 'Warning' sentiment to trigger curiosity.
Limit hashtags to 3-4 highly relevant finance tags (e.g., #FinanceTips, #StockMarketIndia, #Investing) to avoid algorithm confusion.
